messages:
maya-partnerships: Quick sync: we're seeing flaky runs on MI300 for multi‑hour long‑context evals (rebel-13b v3 at 8k). Before customer demos next week we need a short cross‑org mitigation: marketplace SKU hints, routing fallback, SI test window, and a coordinated comm plan.

ryan-eng: Can you share the minimal repro and error?

maya-partnerships: Repro: `rebel-13b@v3`, seq_len=8192, batch=2 on instance `mi300-eu-prod-07`. Log: "GPU OOM during KV-append at step 420". Behavior: steady mem until spike.

cleo-vendor-mi300: Acknowledged. We can reproduce internally. Tentative driver RC ready in ~72h. Short term workaround: set `gpu_mem_guard=0.85` and avoid aggressive batching/quant flags. We'll publish an RC binary for SI runs.

nuar-vendor-gaudi: We'll run parity long-seq tests on Gaudi cluster if you provide commit/tag. No immediate regressions seen but we'll validate.

leo-platform: Mitigation proposal:
- routing policy `fallback-longseq-eu` (canary 5 -> 25 -> 100)% routing rebel-13b traffic to H100/H200 hosts for eu region
- marketplace listing update (non-blocking) to suggest H100/H200 as fallback SKUs for EU customers
- SI integration window: Fri 01:00-07:00 UTC for partner RC & stress runs
- internal comm + embargoed advisory only if RC delayed >72h

tara-cloud: I'll draft the marketplace PR with suggested mapping: `rebel-13b: { eu: [H100-XL, H200-STD], global: [H100-XL] }` and hold until SI window confirmed.

ryan-eng: Also adding a runtime soft-fallback rule: if `seq_len > 4096` prefer H100-compatible kernels for that model-id; toggle via config so we can flip quickly. Need perf/cost delta against H100 to include in comms.

ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-789 "MI300 long‑seq KV growth / OOM". Runbook stub: https://internal/incidents/INC-2026-789 (private).

maya-partnerships: Action items: @leo-platform open routing PR + canary plan, @tara-cloud marketplace draft, @ryan-eng runtime toggle + perf eval, vendors to produce RC/test reports. Reconvene in 48h or when RC available. :thumbsup:
